I am old now, 72 years, and I farm with no schooling but many seasons of experience. This plot is for beans and other legumes, intercropped as we always do here in Mangochi, so I do not waste fertilizer on it — the legumes give back to the soil themselves. I have no money for chemicals on beans, and the rains will water it as always. I will work it with my own hands and family help, maybe a little manure from the goats if I can gather it.
